dvids.title: USS Bulkeley participates in Mavi Balina 2026
dvids.desc: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Bulkeley (DDG 84) participated in Turkish-led exercise Mavi Balina 2026 in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea, Nov. 9-20.
